name: governance-violation
description: chat/delta from the ui domain is a UPCM-002 violation: ui is not in chat/delta's allowedEmitters (only 'chat' is). In Test mode, EventBus.emit pushes the trace with status='blocked' AND throws. Proves that violations produce both a recorded trace AND a runtime throw — the trace is authoritative even when emit fails.

data.delta: ui has no right to emit this
